raw:
I think of a reunion with my old softball team. We had the whole infield at one table, and that made me happy—seeing everybody together instead of thinking of them separately, the way you do when you haven’t seen people for a while.

There was a team photograph being passed around. Looking at a picture like that is different when the people are right there with you. You look down at the photograph, then up at everybody, and you start thinking about being on the team rather than just how long it’s been.

The infield—that was what kept striking me. All of us around one table. Softball makes me think of the people as much as the game, really. I was happy to be part of that group again.
